posts.title: Weekly Check-in 10/31/2026-11/07/2026
posts.description: Hey guys how’s it going? Weekly Check-in time where I was able to be all over the place with stuff these past two weeks. Because of this, I watched two movies, one short film, six tv shows, and four anime. I also read one manhwa, one manga, and one picture book. Onto the Media!!! Movie Addams Family Reunion This was a cute movie involving the Addams Family and I thought that it was good and fun for the whole family…..however, I do feel that Tim Curry was underutilized in this role and a couple of other actors fell flat…..but otherwise it was great for the Halloween season. Because of these points, I have to give this a 3.5 out of 5 stars or 3 sushi . Camp Nowhere This is a movie that had a lot of classic actors and a lot of 90s references, but overall, it reminded me about the old Disney Channel Original Movies that I used to watch when I was young. Its a really fun one to watch for the summer months. Because of these points, I have to give this a 4 out of 5 stars or 4 sushi . Short Fi

posts.title: Spoooooooooooky Media Recap
posts.description: Hey guys how’s it going? An annual tradition has come once again….. Spoooky Media Time!!! A nine-panel horror sequence follows a glowing-eyed figure emerging through a moonlit, fog-covered graveyard. This is where I consume a bunch of spooky media during the fall season!!! This spooky season I watched seven tv shows, seven movies, and two short films. I also read five picture books, four graphic novels, one manhwa, and two volumes of manga. Onto the Media!!!! Inspiration Indie Manga Puppet-X This manga is one of those perfect for the spooky season because its a psychological thriller thats a slowburn that can be intriguing for people who enjoy crime stories and horror. Rught now you can read chapters on Manga Plus, Global Comix and the Drawslides_ instagram. Highly recommend although can be very horrific.
